title: Thermador — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Thermador.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "The True Cooking Experience." Luxury tier. Thermador invented the built-in cooktop in 1947 and has been innovating ever since. Their patented Star burner delivers 18% more even heat coverage than round burners, and ExtraLow simmers at 100 degrees — perfect for melting chocolate without a double boiler. But the real sales weapon is the 1-2-Free bundle program: buy a qualifying cooking package and get a free dishwasher, or buy a larger package and get a free dishwasher plus refrigerator. No other luxury brand gives away $5K+ in free product.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Kitchen remodels where the bundle program creates an unbeatable total value. Customers cross-shopping Wolf who are price-sensitive on the total package.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Thermador:

• 1-2-Free program: buy qualifying cooking, get free dishwasher — buy more, get free fridge too

• Star burner has 56% more coverage area than round burners — no hot spots

• ExtraLow simmer at 100°F — melt chocolate directly in a pan, no double boiler needed

• Home Connect WiFi lets you preheat the oven from the couch

• Only luxury brand offering column refrigeration, pro cooking, AND free appliance bundles
